PMO Reviews El Nino Impact on Agriculture and Economy

The Prime Minister's Office (PMO) held a high-level meeting to review the impact of El Nino on agriculture, water, and fodder preparedness. The meeting, chaired by PK Mishra, directed ministries and states to enhance coordination and vigilance. Reservoir levels in vulnerable districts are being monitored, and a plan has been developed to address potential impacts on farming and inflation. The rainfall deficit has narrowed to 12%.
